title: Robust control
physicalPurpose: Reduce gust-driven wing-root bending across declared modal uncertainty without presenting a numerical grid as flight certification.
objective: Qualify one controller over a declared uncertainty set.

simplifications: One local bending mode represents the ground vibration-test article.
The 27 structured cases are deterministic qualification points, not a claim for every intermediate airframe.
The supplied multiplicative residual envelope is independent design evidence and is not inferred from the favorable time trace.
No nonlinear aeroelasticity, structural damage, flutter clearance, certification or flight operation is represented.

baseline.limitation: Aggressive nominal proportional control ignores the sampled delay and loses damping or stability over the declared flexible-mode set.

change.decision: Accept only a candidate whose three weighted paths and sampled poles pass at every declared structured case; retain all peak locations and time-domain costs.

disturbances: Apply the same +0.10 g gust-equivalent load from 5 through 6 seconds to nominal and robust plant copies.
Repeat the record at all 27 declared natural-frequency, damping and effectiveness cases.
In a separate restored nominal-model case, mark bending data unhealthy from 12 through 13 seconds, restore it, then disable at 14 seconds.

abortPredicates: Any required bending, gust, surface, quality, frequency, pole or uncertainty value is nonfinite, stale, forced, missing or bound incorrectly.
The model set, residual envelope, candidate set, interval, substep, initial state, gust, limits, controller realization or evidence class differs without declaration.
A selected sampled pole is not strictly inside the unit circle or any selected weighted peak reaches one.
Bad bending quality drives a nonzero applied surface, restoration exceeds the declared surface limit, or disabled output is nonzero.
safety.restorationMode: Apply zero surface command for unhealthy data, restore bounded control explicitly, then disable both loops to zero.
safety.physicalApprovalRole: authorised flight-controls engineer with structures, aeroelasticity, instrumentation, test and safety owners
simulationOnlyRestrictions: No physical wing, actuator, shaker, wind-tunnel article or aircraft is operated.
The uncertainty grid and residual envelope are lesson inputs, not measurements from a physical article.
Ground-rig Simulation evidence cannot establish flutter clearance, structural integrity, certification or flight safety.

learning.context: A flexible-wing ground test rig must reduce gust-driven bending despite uncertain modal frequency, damping, effectiveness and residual dynamics.
learning.reason: Adaptive estimation of a few slowly varying parameters cannot safely cover a continuum of resonant and unstructured uncertainty.
theory: Structured uncertainty names physical parameters; multiplicative uncertainty bounds an unparameterized frequency-dependent residual.
Sensitivity, complementary sensitivity and control sensitivity expose disturbance rejection, model-error amplification and surface effort.
Frequency weights turn those paths into explicit requirements and the mixed-sensitivity score retains the worst component rather than an average.
Small-gain, sampled poles and time-domain actuator evidence answer different parts of a bounded robust claim.
learning.workedPrediction: Calculate the weakest-plant low-frequency weighted sensitivity as approximately 0.833 and prove the continuous filtered-PD Routh determinant is positive for the declared positive parameters.
practicalPreparation: Verify the 27 structured cases, residual weight, four candidates, exact sampled realization, frequency range, gust, limits and evidence class.
Declare the three weighted acceptance bounds and time-domain measures before running any candidate.
learning.baseline: Run the nominal Kp=40 proportional loop and retain every failed weighted bound, pole and gust response.
learning.change: Evaluate the four filtered-PD candidates and execute the selected (10,3,0.05) realization on equivalent restored plants.
learning.comparison: Compare all three weighted peaks, gamma, pole radius, bending peak and IAE, settling, surface movement, request, application and saturation.
learning.validation: Prove independent sampled-frequency calculations, scan-level controller agreement, all-case time behavior, bad-quality zero output, restoration and disable.
learning.explanation: Use S, T and KS to connect low-frequency rejection, uncertain resonance and surface effort to the measured tradeoff.

acceptance.window: 0.01 through 100 rad/s over all 27 structured cases

video.viewerOutcome: Distinguish a bounded sampled robust-control qualification from an unsupported general or flight-safety claim.
requiredVisibleEvidence: S T and KS weighted plots
